missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Штаб' is the nominative subject of 'находится'. 'В центре города' uses the prepositional and genitive to locate it. A clean model for a masculine noun.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Штаб' is the accusative direct object of 'построили'. As an inanimate masculine noun, its accusative equals the nominative. 'Новый' is the agreeing adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Штаба' is the genitive required after 'возле' to express proximity. 'Охрана' is the nominative subject of 'стоит'. A practical location pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Штабу' is the dative form after 'к' to express movement toward. 'Пешком' adds the manner of travel. The dative is the natural case after 'к'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Штабом' is the instrumental form required after 'управлять', which governs the instrumental. 'Умело' describes how. A core verb-plus-instrumental pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В штабе' uses the prepositional form 'штабе' after 'в' to mark where the meeting takes place. 'Собрание' is the nominative subject. A useful indoor location.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'К штабу' uses the dative after 'к' to mark the destination. 'Прямо' adds directness, and 'дорога' is the nominative subject. Reinforces the directional dative.

Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Штабом' is the instrumental used after the past tense 'было' to name a former role. 'Это здание' is the nominative subject. A standard 'used to be' construction.

Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Штаба' takes the genitive singular after 'два'. 'В городе' marks the location, and 'работают' agrees with the plural sense. A core counting pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Штабы' is the nominative plural subject of 'соединены'. 'Города' is the genitive specifying which city's, and 'связью' is the instrumental of means. Good for plural practice.
